title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Mohegan Sun Event Center, Uncasville | 1999
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Mohegan Sun Event Center at the Mohegan Sun casino in Uncasville, Connecticut, USA, on 19 February 1999.

It was the sixth show by the fifth All-Starr Band, and the first of two consecutive nights in Uncasville. Their US tour lasted for 30 dates in February and March 1999.

Starr had previously performed at the Mohegan Sun Event Center on 2 June 1997.

The fifth All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Todd Rundgren: vocals, guitar, percussion
  • Gary Brooker: vocals, keyboards, organ
  • Jack Bruce: vocals, bass guitar, keyboards
  • Timmy Cappello: vocals, saxophone, keyboards, harmonica, guitar
  • Simon Kirke: vocals, drums

  • ‘Act Naturally’
  • ‘Whisky Train’ (Gary Brooker)
  • ‘I Saw The Light’ (Todd Rundgren)
  • ‘Sunshine Of Your Love’ (Jack Bruce)

  • ‘Photograph’

  • ‘With A Little Help From My Friends’
